newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Nov 18.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Nov 18.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on November 18:
WASHINGTON - The far-reaching immigration law that took effect last month left many thorny questions unresolved, issues that are likely to spur renewed debates when Congress reconvenes next year.
WASHINGTON - FBI Director Louis Freeh is coming under increasing scrutiny after a series of vexing and potentially damaging controversies over the past year.
BANGKOK - Thailand is resisting a full-scale assault on its market by American tobacco companies.
GOMA, ZAIRE - An estimated 400,000 Rwandan refugees are heading home from this refugee camp, but thousands are too hungry and tired to finish the trek.
TOKYO - In Tokyo's rare green spaces, cliques of veteran park mothers have their own hierarchies and impose rules of obedience for newcomers.
